title: Recovering Posterior Beliefs in Credit Risk: A Latent-State EM Extension of the Information-Geometric Framework
abstract: arXiv:2608.29786v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a latent-state framework for recovering borrower-level posterior beliefs in credit-risk analysis. Creditworthiness and financial fragility are represented as latent dimensions, while observed borrower scores follow a finite Gaussian mixture model and default depends on the latent profile. Borrower-specific probabilities of default are obtained by averaging profile-specific default probabilities over the posterior distribution of latent states. A joint Expectation--Maximization procedure is used to estimate the mixture structure and the profile-specific default probabilities from observed score--default pairs. After estimation, predictive posterior beliefs are computed using the observed scores alone, thereby preserving the information available before default realization. A controlled simulation experiment evaluates the recovery of structural parameters, posterior beliefs, and borrower-level probabilities of default.

translated_title: 信用风险中后验信念的恢复：信息几何框架的潜在状态EM扩展
translated_abstract: 本文开发了一个潜在状态框架，用于在信用风险分析中恢复借款人层面的后验信念。信用状况和财务脆弱性被表示为潜在维度，而观察到的借款人评分遵循有限高斯混合模型，违约则取决于潜在特征。借款人特定的违约概率是通过对潜在状态的后验分布上的特征特定违约概率取平均而获得的。研究采用联合期望最大化（EM）方法，从观察到的评分-违约配对数据中估计混合结构和特征特定的违约概率。估计完成后，预测性后验信念仅使用观察到的评分进行计算，从而保留了违约实现之前可获得的信息。一项受控模拟实验评估了结构参数、后验信念以及借款人层面违约概率的恢复效果。
tldr: 本文提出了一种潜在状态EM扩展框架，利用高斯混合模型和联合期望最大化方法，在信用风险分析中恢复借款人层面的后验信念和违约概率，且预测仅依赖违约发生前的评分信息。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a latent-state EM extension of the information-geometric framework that recovers borrower-level posterior beliefs and default probabilities in credit risk analysis, using a finite Gaussian mixture model with joint Expectation-Maximization estimation and predictions based solely on pre-default score information.
